purpose: Non-admission public source discovery of missing European catastrophe model hazard, hydrology, protection standards, vulnerability, historic economic and insurance-loss components; not a data input allow-list.

entries.name: Copernicus Enhanced European Windstorm tracks and footprints
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Event tracks and 72h peak 10-m gust footprints at ERA5 resolution and downscaled products
entries.note: Unlike existing CLIMK-WINDS, EWS is an all-season updated reanalysis family. Pin event ID, algorithm (TRACK/TempestExtremes), gust temporal statistic, resolution and release. Reanalysis-derived tracks must not be mistaken for independent measured winds or full annual stochastic catalogs.

entries.name: Copernicus EU-Hydro River Network Database
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Drainage lines, lakes, river networks and catchment topology, vector EPSG:3035
entries.note: Do not confuse river lines with water depth, levee positions or live discharge; reconcile geometry age and projection against existing JRC river flood maps.

entries.name: COASTPROS-EU coastal flood protection standards
entries.resolution_or_granularity: European coastal-defence information and region-linked design/policy protection standards
entries.note: Observed defence structure, policy standard and modeled proxy must be separately labelled. No blanket claim of exact levee geometries or zero flooding below design return period; model overtopping and failure uncertainties.

entries.name: FLOPROS flood protection standards
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Three design, policy and modeled flood standard layers expressed as return periods
entries.note: Policy and modeled layers are NOT measured engineering characteristics. Freeze data/source version and spatial support before combining with 2026 JRC hazard rasters. Do not double-count overlapping input with COASTPROS-EU.

entries.name: EEA Floods Directive reference spatial datasets V3.0
entries.provider: European Environment Agency / EU Member States
entries.resolution_or_granularity: GeoPackage and services for management units and potentially significant flood risk areas
entries.note: Official flood area reporting is not continuous flood-depth geometry or a probabilistic event set. Align national reporting epoch, exact map class, geometry and source licensing.

entries.name: JRC global flood depth-damage functions and maximum loss values
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Fractional damage by depth and asset/land-use class plus country maximum damage benchmarks
entries.note: Key peril-to-loss conversion. Curves use expert judgement and literature; preserve class, units, damage definition, currency year, flood depth datum and uncertainty. Damage value is not insured loss or insurer-specific deductible result.

entries.name: EFEHR European Building Vulnerability Data Repository v2.1
entries.spatial_scope: Europe, classes in GEM Building Taxonomy
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Seismic capacity, fragility, damage-to-loss and vulnerability functions for building taxonomies
entries.note: Compare intensity measure (PGA/SA etc), soil/site response and class mappings with GEM exposure. Release is scientific curves not empirical insured claims. Rights of specific files require review.

entries.name: EEA economic losses from climate-related extremes in Europe
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Country/hazard/period aggregate economic and insured loss observations and estimates
entries.note: Not individual insurer claims, event damage footprint or independent proof of local vulnerability. Preserve indexation, base year, source lineage and missing insured values, including EIOPA dashboard overlap.

entries.name: EIOPA Catastrophe Data Hub for insured exposure and losses
entries.provider: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority
entries.spatial_scope: Limited sample of European non-life insurers
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Residential/commercial flood and windstorm insured exposure; reported incurred building losses for flood, wildfire and windstorm events
entries.note: EIOPA specifies 35 large groups and 9 solo undertakings; no 100% market representativeness. Preserve peril, geography, insurer reporting population, coverage and incurred-vs-paid basis. No individual policy inference.

entries.name: EIOPA insurance protection gap dashboard
entries.provider: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Peril/country protection gap indicators, modeled risk and insurance coverage context
entries.note: Country/peril aggregates, not contract-level exposure. Dashboard may re-use EEA historical data; overlapping lineage is not independent model validation.

entries.name: Copernicus CEMS historical fire danger indices
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ERA5-derived gridded historical wildfire danger and Fire Weather Index variables
entries.note: Fire-weather potential does not provide observed burned perimeters, ignition points, exposure loss or direct flame intensity; compare against existing EFFIS burned area without treating shared forcing as independent.

entries.name: XWS European extreme windstorm tracks and footprints
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 50 significant storm tracks and modelled peak gust footprints at about 25 km, raw and recalibrated
entries.note: A selected-extremes catalogue cannot establish annual storm frequency. Preserve overlap with C3S and CLIMK, footprint resolution and source calibration; avoid double counting.

entries.name: European Tsunami Risk Service data products
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Research-accessible tsunami fragility, consequence and vulnerability product listings
entries.note: Catalogued research candidate only; need identify actual quantitative file, Europe coverage, wave depth/velocity/intensity metric, licensing and exposure taxonomy before using.

entries.name: Pan-European coastal flood probability data for present and future climate
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Coastal flood probability products comparing present/future climate scenario assumptions
entries.note: Inspect actual file semantics before inferring inundation depth. Local sea-level datum, defence assumptions, climate scenario and vintage must align with coastal building/exposure layers.
